newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-TENDULKAR WANTS FRESH START.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TENDULKAR WANTS FRESH START.

text.p: India captain Sachin Tendulkar, recently involved in controversy over team selection, said on Thursday he wanted to forget the past and start afresh with the Asia Cup competition.
"I am going into this tournament with an open frame of mind. It's a new season for me," Tendulkar said ahead of Friday's match against world champions Sri Lanka.
"We are not thinking of what happened in the past. Neither are we thinking about what is going to happen in the future," Tendulkar said.
He had been quoted by Indian newspaper Aajkal as saying that he had been given a B-grade team. But Tendulkar has denied saying that.

"Everybody knows Sri Lanka is playing top cricket. To beat them we have to get big runs, to score as many as possible. That's what one-day cricket is becoming like. We have a team to do that," Tendulkar said.
India will name their team on the morning of the match as they have not had an opportunity to practise at the stadium.

Sri Lanka, two points up after their win over Pakistan in the opening game, are concerned about the poor form of wicket-keeper Romesh Kaluwitharana. Lanka de Silva will play if Kaluwitharana is dropped from an otherwise unchanged side.
Sri Lanka need only to beat India to reach the final. Their last game will be against Bangladesh, who lost to Pakistan on Wednesday.

Sri Lanka (from): Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Mavan Atapattu, Aravinda de Silva, Roshan Mahanama, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Kumara Dharmasena, Ruwan Kalpage, Chaminda Vaas, Muthiah Muralitharan, Sajeeva de Silva, Lanka de Silva, Upul Chandana.

India (from): Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Navjot Sidhu, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Saba Karim, Anil Kumble, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvila, Noel David, Nilesh Kulkarni, Debasis Mohanty.
